run_vcr_qa_evaluation: run the VCR Q_A evaluation script with QA and QAR result JSON files and ground truth annotations
run_vcr_qar_evaluation: run the VCR QA_R evaluation script to compute rationale accuracy from prediction and ground truth files
run_vcr_qar_combined_evaluation: run the VCR Q_AR evaluation script to compute combined question-answer-rationale accuracy
load_vcr_ground_truth: load VCR val.jsonl ground truth annotations and extract answer and rationale labels
compute_vcr_accuracy_metrics: compute Q_A, QA_R, and Q_AR accuracy metrics from prediction results and ground truth
